newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss launch new series of 12-month claims.
newsitem.headline: Swiss launch new series of 12-month claims.

text.p: The Swiss federal government said it was launching a new series A.397 of 12-month money market claims, with subscriptions to close on Tuesday, July 29 at 0900 GMT.
Payment is July 31. The claims mature on July 30, 1998. The issue is in denominations of 50,000 Swiss francs.
The latest offer follows issue of a three-month series 3.396 totaling 1.0 billion Swiss francs, priced at 99.672 to yield 1.302 percent.
